Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Shahid Akhtar,Pankaj Kumar Tripathi,Rohit Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard Shri Divya Prakash, learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.350 of 2017, under Section 498A, 304B, 302 IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Laharpur, District Sitapur.
3. This is the fourth bail application of the applicant.
The first bail application was rejected on 18.08.2021 for want of prosecution.
The second bail application was rejected on 30.09.2022 with directions to conclude the trial within six months.
The third bail application was rejected on 18.05.2023 and once again directions were issued to conclude the trial within six months.
Sandeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl.

entities.text: Sandeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Chief Secy.

... on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113711807/
1 4.
It is argued that despite directions on two occasions, the trial is not proceeding.
Out of 13 witnesses, only 3 witnesses have been examined and the applicant is in custody since 20.09.2017 having no criminal antecedent.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the fact that the applicant is in custody for the last six years and there is no likelihood of the trial being completed in near future coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedent, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of long tenure of pre-trial detention which prima-facie violates his rights under Article 21 of the Constitution of India.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.
